mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions and rising recession risk, causing a short-term sell-off in the S&P 500 as investors price in weaker corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous month-over-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a contraction in the broader consumer demand, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns as corporate earnings growth expectations are revised downward.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 105, the S&P 500 tends to have positive returns over the next 60 days as the strong manufacturing sector supports corporate earnings growth during late-cycle expansion.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO > 105.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the CPIAUCSL inflation rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS increases month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200.0 thousand units signals a slowdown in the housing sector, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the broader consumer demand weakens.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where HOUST falls below 1200.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous month-over-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and quarter-over-quarter increase in GDP (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings growth is supported.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where both INDPRO and GDPC1 increase (INDPRO: month-over-month, GDPC1: quarter-over-quarter).
